metadata.summary: A newly widowed interpreter in Paris is pursued over missing wartime money. A charming stranger offers help, but his shifting identity makes him difficult to trust.
metadata.title: Charade

metadata.summary: Strangers shelter in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the dead attack outside. Fear and conflict inside the house threaten their efforts to survive.
metadata.title: Night of the Living Dead

metadata.summary: A projectionist accused of theft dreams himself into a detective film, where impossible escapes and elaborate stunts turn him into the hero he hopes to be.
metadata.title: Sherlock Jr.

metadata.summary: An estate agent travels to Count Orlok’s remote castle, unaware that his client is a vampire. Orlok follows him to Wisborg, bringing plague and threatening his wife, Ellen.
metadata.title: Nosferatu

metadata.summary: In a futuristic city divided between wealthy rulers and underground workers, the ruler’s son discovers the human cost of its machinery. A robot disguised as a young reformer drives the city toward revolt.
metadata.title: Metropolis

metadata.summary: Professor Challenger leads an expedition to a remote South American plateau where dinosaurs still survive. Bringing a living specimen back to London turns a scientific triumph into chaos.
metadata.title: The Lost World

metadata.summary: During the American Civil War, Union raiders steal a locomotive with the engineer’s fiancée aboard. Johnnie Gray pursues them through enemy territory, determined to recover both his engine and Annabelle.
metadata.title: The General

metadata.summary: A mysterious figure beneath the Paris Opera helps a young singer become a star. His devotion turns possessive, drawing Christine and her lover into the hidden passages below the theater.
metadata.title: The Phantom of the Opera

metadata.summary: A struggling florist’s assistant brings an unusual plant into the shop to save his job. Business flourishes, but the plant’s appetite for human blood draws him into a series of increasingly grisly predicaments.
metadata.title: The Little Shop of Horrors

metadata.summary: An aspiring actress finds a mentor and husband in a celebrated Hollywood actor. As her career takes off, his fading fame and alcoholism threaten the life they have built together.
metadata.title: A Star Is Born

metadata.summary: A wealthy young woman recruits a homeless man for a scavenger hunt, then hires him as her family’s butler. His composure unsettles the eccentric household, while his past proves more complicated than anyone expects.
metadata.title: My Man Godfrey

metadata.summary: A war-crimes investigator follows a fugitive’s trail to a quiet New England town. A respected teacher’s carefully constructed identity begins to unravel as the investigator closes in on the Nazi hiding behind it.
metadata.title: The Stranger

metadata.summary: Flying saucers appear over California as aliens put a plan to reanimate the dead into motion. A pilot and the local authorities investigate the cemetery where the visitors are turning corpses against the living.
metadata.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space

metadata.summary: Facing financial ruin on Christmas Eve, George Bailey begins to believe his life has been a failure. An angel shows him how profoundly his family and hometown would have suffered without him.
metadata.title: It's a Wonderful Life

metadata.summary: Four soldiers stranded behind enemy lines try to escape through a forest during an unnamed war. Their encounter with a local woman and a nearby enemy outpost exposes the fear and violence within their own ranks.
metadata.title: Fear and Desire

metadata.summary: A mystery novelist rents a country mansion where a stolen fortune has been hidden. As a masked killer stalks the house, she and her companions must unravel the mystery before becoming his next victims.
metadata.title: The Bat

metadata.summary: After a plague transforms people into nocturnal creatures, an immune scientist spends his days hunting them and his nights barricaded at home. An encounter with another survivor challenges his belief that he understands what remains of humanity.
metadata.title: The Last Man on Earth

metadata.summary: A school principal warns parents with a sensationalized story of teenagers drawn into a marijuana dealer’s parties. This anti-drug melodrama follows the ensuing deception, violence, and tragedy through the exaggerated claims of its cautionary tale.
metadata.title: Reefer Madness

metadata.summary: A trailer for Stanley Donen’s romantic mystery.
metadata.title: Charade — Trailer

metadata.summary: An anthology hosted by John Newland dramatizes accounts of unexplained and paranormal events.
metadata.title: One Step Beyond

metadata.summary: Ozzie and Harriet Nelson navigate family life with sons David and Ricky, whose school days give way to dating, marriage, and work.
metadata.title: The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet

metadata.summary: Bud and Lou struggle to find work and pay their boarding-house rent, turning everyday situations into comic routines and misunderstandings.
metadata.title: The Abbott and Costello Show

metadata.parentTitle: The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet
metadata.title: Season 1

metadata.summary: On their honeymoon, a bride begins behaving as though she is someone else, alarming her husband.
metadata.title: The Bride Possessed

metadata.summary: A woman troubled by dreams of drowning learns that her honeymoon will take her aboard the Titanic.
metadata.title: Night of April 14th

metadata.summary: A reluctant blood donor fears that saving a woman will create a psychic connection to her future.
metadata.title: Delusion

metadata.grandparentTitle: The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet
metadata.summary: David takes a babysitting job, and an anxious Ozzie decides to check on him.
metadata.title: David the Babysitter

metadata.summary: Lou’s toothache leads him to a dentist, then into an increasingly unlikely search for free treatment.
metadata.title: The Dentist's Office

metadata.summary: H. G. Wells (1866–1946), author of The Time Machine and The War of the Worlds.
metadata.title: H. G. Wells

metadata.summary: Bram Stoker’s 1897 novel follows Jonathan Harker, Mina Murray, and their allies as they confront Count Dracula. This LibriVox edition is read by volunteers.
metadata.title: Dracula

metadata.summary: A Victorian inventor travels to the distant future and encounters the Eloi and Morlocks. This is the fourth LibriVox version of Wells’s 1895 novella.
metadata.title: The Time Machine

metadata.summary: Wells’s 1898 novel depicts a Martian invasion of England. This LibriVox reading by Rebecca is cataloged by Project Gutenberg.
metadata.title: The War of the Worlds

metadata.summary: After discovering oil on their land, the Clampetts move from the Ozarks to Beverly Hills. Their rural habits bewilder their wealthy neighbors and the banker determined to keep their fortune.
metadata.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

metadata.summary: Oil beneath Jed’s land makes the Clampetts millionaires. Cousin Pearl persuades the family to trade their mountain cabin for a mansion in Beverly Hills.
metadata.title: The Clampetts Strike Oil

metadata.summary: The Clampetts struggle with the unfamiliar comforts of their mansion, while Miss Hathaway mistakes the new owners for household servants.
metadata.title: Getting Settled

metadata.summary: Jed pretends to be ill to cheer up homesick Granny. Her mountain remedies soon draw Mr. Drysdale and his physician into the deception.
metadata.title: Jed Gets the Misery

metadata.summary: From their rooms at Baker Street, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate crimes that leave Scotland Yard baffled, testing their deductions against deception, superstition, and elaborate criminal schemes.
metadata.title: Sherlock Holmes

metadata.summary: Newly returned to London, Dr. Watson becomes Holmes’s roommate and helps investigate a murder in which the victim’s fiancée appears to be the obvious suspect.
metadata.title: The Case of the Cunningham Heritage

metadata.summary: Lady Beryl admits to a killing in her home, but Holmes doubts her confession and searches for the person she may be protecting.
metadata.title: The Case of Lady Beryl

metadata.summary: A shooting inside a secluded Sussex castle sends Holmes and Watson searching for an explanation beyond the two apparent suspects.
metadata.title: The Case of the Pennsylvania Gun

metadata.summary: Outlawed after returning from the Crusades, Robin Hood gathers allies in Sherwood Forest. Together they defend villagers against corrupt nobles and the Sheriff of Nottingham.
metadata.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

metadata.summary: Robin returns from the Crusades to find another man occupying his estate. Branded an outlaw, he takes refuge in Sherwood Forest.
metadata.title: The Coming of Robin Hood

metadata.summary: Robin takes money from an exploitative lender and returns it to struggling villagers, bringing him into conflict with both the Sheriff and his fellow outlaws.
metadata.title: The Moneylender

metadata.summary: Robin helps Wat Longfellow escape servitude so he can marry the widow Winifred, despite the obstacles placed in their way by a local bailiff.
metadata.title: A Village Wooing

metadata.summary: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden, and Dr. Zarkov travel between planets for the Galaxy Bureau of Investigation, confronting dangerous inventions, ruthless rulers, and threats to interplanetary peace.
metadata.title: Flash Gordon

metadata.summary: Flash, Dale, and Zarkov investigate deaths on a distant planet after a surviving explorer claims his expedition was destroyed by an ancient curse.
metadata.title: Flash Gordon and the Planet of Death

metadata.summary: A friend sent to investigate Akim’s brutal regime returns determined to kill Flash. Flash and Dale travel to the planet to uncover what happened.
metadata.title: Akim the Terrible

metadata.summary: Flash and Dale come to the aid of a prospector and his daughter when space pirates try to seize his valuable mineral discovery.
metadata.title: The Claim Jumpers

metadata.summary: Widow Lucy Carmichael tackles family life and a succession of ambitious schemes. Her adventures eventually take her to California, where her work at a bank repeatedly exasperates Mr. Mooney.
metadata.title: The Lucy Show

metadata.summary: George Burns recognizes Lucy’s comic talent during a visit to the bank and recruits her for his nightclub act, with Mr. Mooney eager to help her leave.
metadata.title: Lucy with George Burns

metadata.summary: Lucy boards Mr. Mooney’s submarine to obtain his signature on bank paperwork. When it sails before she can leave, she must pass herself off as a sailor.
metadata.title: Lucy and the Submarine

metadata.summary: Lucy hopes to win Jack Benny’s business for the bank by constructing a vault with security measures even more elaborate than those protecting his own fortune.
metadata.title: Lucy Gets Jack Benny's Account

metadata.summary: Comedy writer Rob Petrie juggles the demands of a television variety show with family life in New Rochelle. His colleagues, wife Laura, and son Ritchie turn everyday misunderstandings into comic complications.
metadata.title: The Dick Van Dyke Show

metadata.summary: Rob brings home two ducklings from work, and Ritchie eagerly adopts them. When caring for the birds becomes difficult, Rob must help his son understand what is best for them.
metadata.title: Never Name a Duck

metadata.summary: Rob discovers that Laura has a bank account he knows nothing about. His curiosity turns into an elaborate guessing game about why she has been saving the money.
metadata.title: Bank Book 6565696

metadata.summary: Buddy’s brother Blackie joins the Petries for dinner and a game of pool. Rob mistakes his guest’s apparent lack of skill for an easy opportunity to win.
metadata.title: Hustling the Hustler

metadata.summary: Los Angeles detective Joe Friday and his partners work through criminal cases one interview and piece of evidence at a time. The series follows the routines and pressures of police investigations in a documentary-like style.
metadata.title: Dragnet

metadata.summary: Friday and Jacobs question a man suspected of involvement in a disappearance. His cool denials begin to falter under persistent questioning about what happened to the missing man.
metadata.title: The Big Cast

metadata.summary: A secretary is found beaten to death in her office. Friday and Jacobs sift through the accounts of the men who saw her that night to identify her killer.
metadata.title: The Big September Man

metadata.summary: A man climbs onto a ninth-floor ledge and threatens to jump at a set time. Friday and the emergency crews race to reach him before the deadline.
metadata.title: The Big Jump

metadata.summary: Ben Cartwright and his sons Adam, Hoss, and Little Joe run the Ponderosa ranch near Virginia City, Nevada. Their loyalty to one another is tested by frontier disputes, dangerous strangers, and the changing West.
metadata.title: Bonanza

metadata.summary: Ben and Adam face execution after being convicted of a murder they did not commit. Hoss and Little Joe seek help, while a mysterious drifter takes an interest in the case.
metadata.title: The Avenger

metadata.summary: An English couple visits the Ponderosa, where Lady Beatrice doubts her husband’s courage. A hunting expedition with Adam puts their strained marriage to a dangerous test.
metadata.title: The Last Trophy

metadata.summary: After a bank robbery, a young outlaw takes a job at the Ponderosa to monitor the search for his gang. Little Joe grows suspicious of the new ranch hand.
metadata.title: Showdown

metadata.summary: A science-fiction anthology presents independent stories of alien encounters, troubling inventions, and experiments with unforeseen consequences. Each tale follows a different cast into a scientific or supernatural mystery.
metadata.title: Tales of Tomorrow

metadata.summary: An inventor on trial for murder describes a remarkable discovery inside a sealed cavern. He struggles to convince the court that what he found threatens far more than his own freedom.
metadata.title: Verdict from Space

metadata.summary: Scientists discover that a colleague’s planned nuclear experiment could have catastrophic consequences. Reaching the isolated researcher before he begins becomes a desperate race against time.
metadata.title: Blunder

metadata.summary: An antique dealer brings a strange crystal egg to a professor for examination. The images within suggest a window onto another world, while an insistent buyer presses to obtain it.
metadata.title: The Crystal Egg

metadata.summary: Victor Frankenstein creates a living being, then abandons it, setting creator and creature on a path of isolation and revenge. Cori Samuel reads the original 1818 text in this 2011 LibriVox edition.
metadata.title: Frankenstein

metadata.summary: Robert Louis Stevenson (1850–1894), author of Treasure Island and The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.
metadata.title: Robert Louis Stevenson

metadata.summary: Jim Hawkins discovers a treasure map and sails aboard the Hispaniola, where Long John Silver and his fellow pirates plot mutiny. Mark F. Smith reads Stevenson’s 1883 adventure novel in this fourth LibriVox version, cataloged in 2013.
metadata.title: Treasure Island
The Last of the Blind Man
What I Heard in the Apple Barrel
End of the First Day's Fighting

metadata.title: Lewis Carroll

metadata.summary: Alice follows a White Rabbit into a world of talking animals, impossible rules, and the Queen of Hearts. Craig Franklin reads Carroll’s 1865 novel in this seventh LibriVox version, cataloged in 2020.
metadata.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
A Caucus-Race and a Long Tale
The Rabbit Sends in a Little Bill

metadata.summary: Paul Bäumer and his schoolmates enlist in the German army with dreams of glory. Life in the trenches of World War I replaces their enthusiasm with fear, grief, and a growing distance from the civilians who sent them to fight.
metadata.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
metadata.titleSort: All Quiet on the Western Front

metadata.summary: A society hostess welcomes celebrated explorer Captain Spaulding to her country estate. When a valuable painting becomes the target of rival substitution schemes, the Marx Brothers turn the house party into a tangle of mistaken identities, musical interruptions, and absurd detective work.
